draft-talk.team-leader.body: First-round count: {leaders} {leadVerb} with {count} selections. That's a lot of players reaching the front of the draft together.
{leaders}: {count} first-round picks, the highest school total in this class. Development matters. So does getting that many prospects to draft day healthy.

draft-talk.conference-leader.body: Conference draft check: {conferences} {leadVerb} with {count} first-round picks. That is this year's count, not a free pass to claim every team in the league was great.

draft-talk.congrats.body: {count} {school} players drafted. Congrats to {names}{more}. Watching guys you cheered for get that call never gets old
From {school} to Sundays. {count} draft picks this year. Big congrats to {names}{more}. Go make your own story

draft-talk.empty.body: No {school} players drafted this year. Not the result we wanted. Hope our guys get a chance as free agents and make somebody regret passing
An entire draft without {school} having a name called. Yeah that stings. Wishing our guys well wherever the next opportunity comes

draft-talk.conference-fan.body: {count} first-round picks out of {school}. You're welcome, {conference}. We'll be bringing this up all summer

draft-talk.top-ten.body: {school}'s {position} {playerName} to the {nflTeam} at No. {pick}. A top-ten investment means expectations arrive immediately. I'll be watching how they build around this pick.
No. {pick}: {school}'s {position} {playerName}, {nflTeam}. Fun landing spot. The next part is finding the right role, not declaring somebody a star before the first practice.

draft-talk.nfl-haul.body: One of my favorite hauls on this draft board: the {nflTeam} landed {names}. I like the starting point. Getting those picks into productive roles is the real test.

roster.underdog.body: Under-the-radar watch: {school} is involved with 2-star {prospectType}{position} {playerName}{originDetail}. A quieter recruitment and a chance to write a different story.

roster.rival-transfer.body: Across the rivalry line: {starDescription}transfer {position} {playerName} has committed to {school} from {formerSchool}. Both fanbases are going to have thoughts on this one.

roster.offer.body: AGTG! Blessed to receive an offer from {school}. Thankful for the opportunity and everybody supporting me through this process
Offer from {school}! Appreciate the coaches believing in me. Excited to see where this goes

roster.transfer-offer.body: Grateful for an offer from {school}. After my time at {formerSchool}, I'm looking for the right place for this next chapter.

roster.announce.body: Committed to {school}. Appreciate everyone who's been part of this journey. Ready for what's next
{school} is home. Thank you to my family and everybody who had my back through this recruitment

roster.transfer-announce.body: After my time at {formerSchool}, I'm committed to {school} for the next chapter. Grateful for the people who helped me get here. Let's get to work.

roster.destination.body: Transfer update: {starDescription}{position} {playerName} is committed to {school} from {formerSchool}. A real addition to this class, not just another name on the interest list.

roster.interest.body: Transfer {position} {playerName}{originDetail} currently has {schools} among the leading schools. Those are the destinations to track; there is no commitment yet.
Keeping an eye on {position} {playerName}{originDetail}. {schools} are in the current leading group. Fit and opportunity will make this recruitment interesting.
My shortlist for transfer {position} {playerName}{originDetail} starts with {schools}, the current leading group. I'd watch those schools closely. This is a projection of the race, not a commitment.

roster.departure-kind.body: Good luck with the next chapter, {targetHandle}. Appreciate what you gave {school}. Hope it works out for you

roster.departure-sour.body: {targetHandle} leaving {school} still stings. We'll be cheering for the guys who stayed. No free passes when we see you again

roster.pitch.body: {targetHandle} come to {school}. We can definitely make room for a player like you
{school} is right there, {targetHandle}. Just saying. We'd love to see you in our colors

roster.rival-fan.body: {targetHandle} from {formerSchool} to {school}? Of all the schools you could've picked. That rivalry game just got personal

roster.welcome.body: Welcome to {school}, {targetHandle}. Another piece for this team. Can't wait to see you out there

roster.unsigned.body: Still available: {starDescription}{prospectType}{position} {playerName} is uncommitted. {recruitRankDetail} This recruitment remains open.
